profile.title: Leverage Points: Places to Intervene in a System
profile.canonical_definition: Donella Meadows's ordered account of places to intervene in systems, ranging from parameters and feedback structures to goals, paradigms and the capacity to remain unattached to paradigms.
profile.summary: Leverage Points orders potential interventions from parameters through feedback and rules to goals, paradigms and the ability to move among paradigms.
profile.why_it_matters: The essay is useful precisely because it combines a memorable hierarchy with repeated cautions: leverage depends on direction and context, systems resist change, and the list is not a recipe.
key_distinctions: parameter vs information vs rule vs goal
historical_lineage: Donella Meadows's policy and teaching work
common_misreadings: the list identifies one best intervention
profile.editorial_note: Developed from public primary, institutional and publisher sources. Open to correction, rival interpretation and stronger evidence.
